name: Lima
english_description: The FluffOS project's own reference mudlib (limalib.dev) -- a notable independent, English-language, modern-design LPC framework, not derived from the classic Chinese-lineage LPMud codebases in this collection. Centralized natural-language command parser, capability-based security daemon, and a wizard-oriented Unix-like shell rather than the usual add_action/wizlist model. Onboarded per AGENTS.md 2.3 (already-git-hosted, already-FluffOS-targeted source).
